items.title: General Motors (GM) Is Under Pressure In The US Auto Market
items.summary: General Motors (NYSE:GM) faces fresh pressure on its long-held US sales lead as Toyota gains market share through hybrids. Toyota’s hybrid focused push in the US is narrowing the sales volume gap with GM and raises the risk that GM could lose its top automaker position. The shift highlights a clash between GM’s emphasis on higher margin trucks and SUVs and Toyota’s volume driven hybrid strategy.
